activities.name: Mara River crossings
activities.note: the herds are elsewhere on the migration circuit the rest of the year - the wildlife is not absent, the crossings are

windows.reason: the migration reaches the northern Serengeti and crosses the Mara; August and September are when most of the herds are on that stretch

activities.name: Wildebeest calving (Ndutu and the southern plains)
activities.note: a few weeks of the migration's year, on the southern short-grass plains rather than in the north

windows.reason: the herds drop their calves on the Ndutu and southeastern plains - thousands a day at the peak, with the predators that follow them
